title: Simple Spawns
description: This is a simple plugin that allows a admin to set a spawn location and then users can do /spawn to go to it.
body: SimpleSpawns is a lightweight Minecraft server plugin designed to make managing spawn points effortless. Admins can quickly set the server’s spawn location using the /setspawn command, ensuring players always return to the right spot. For players, the /spawn command provides a simple way to teleport back to the designated spawn point, whether for safety, convenience, or regrouping with friends. With its minimal setup and easy-to-use commands, SimpleSpawns keeps things straightforward while enhancing server organization and player experience.
